description: This file contains functions related to device-specific operations for the BCM4908 platform, including reading UBI metadata, setting environment configs, verifying and managing the root filesystem data, and interacting with firmware environment variables.

methods.name: get_hex_u32_le
methods.description: Reads 4 bytes from a specified offset in a file, returns them as a hexadecimal string in little-endian order.

methods.name: bcm4908_pkgtb_setup_env_config
methods.description: Sets up environment configuration for UBI volume access and metadata handling by reading volume size and writing config to /tmp/env.config.

methods.name: bcm4908_committed_image_seq
methods.description: Retrieves the current committed image sequence number from UBI metadata via environment variables.

methods.name: bcm4908_verify_rootfs_data
methods.description: Verifies and manages the 'rootfs_data' UBI volume, ensuring it matches the current firmware and is correctly mounted, cleaned, or assigned as needed.
